fusions.name: Eight-Armed Hug
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. You crush it in every limb, which deals 9 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Weight on the Web
fusions.desc: Rears and drops your full weight, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hibernaculum
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 14 health to you. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Back in the Burrow
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
